notes: Added human-only Makefile targets git-commit (add -A + commit NOTE + push) and git-revert (reset --hard HEAD~1 + push --force, with REVERT confirmation prompt). Block comment + [HUMAN-ONLY] tag in help output marks both as forbidden for AI assistants per AGENTS.md operationalSafety.

Reworked git helpers per spec: 'make git' / 'make git.revert' (dot-style names) now dispatch to scripts/git_helper.py (stdlib, cross-platform). Commit message is auto-built from phases.csv rows added since HEAD; if there are uncommitted changes but no new tracker rows, exits 2 with a friendly emoji-prefixed log directing the human to run 'make track-add' first. git.revert keeps the REVERT confirmation prompt. Help regex extended to accept '.' in target names.

Restored git helpers after revert. New design per spec: only 'make git' (commit + push) and 'make git.dry' (preview, no side effects); git.revert removed entirely. scripts/git_helper.py now builds Conventional Commits messages — type inferred per row by counting keyword hits across feat/fix/refactor/docs/test/perf/build/ci/style rules with TYPE_PRIORITY tiebreak (refactor beats fix on equal hits, etc.); scope = phase-N.M; multi-row commits roll up under the highest-priority type. Smart guard: ❌ + 📝 emoji exit if uncommitted changes exist but no new phases.csv rows since HEAD. Cross-platform Python 3.8+ stdlib only. ✨ exits cleanly on a clean tree.

Introduced xops/ tooling tree. Moved scripts/git_helper.py → xops/makefile/git_helper.py and decomposed all Makefile target bodies into 9 stdlib-only Python modules under xops/makefile/ (env, services, ai_commands, server_api, db, logs, tests, cleanup, status, git_helper) sharing _common.py (compose runner, pretty logger, dispatch helper). Each Make target is now a one-line dispatcher (@$(XOPS)/<module>.py <subcommand>); Make keeps the dependency graph, Python owns the work. db-migrate's bash for-loop and server-* curl pipelines are now real cross-platform Python (urllib + subprocess); compose binary is overridable via NEGELIR_COMPOSE env var. track-* and help intentionally remain inline (already thin Python wrappers / Makefile-native idiom). Created xops/README.md documenting layout + conventions + how to add new targets/areas. Updated AGENTS.md §1, §5, §7 to point at xops/ and forbid a generic top-level scripts/ folder.
